regulation_clause.text: Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

gold.gold_rationale: The 2016 clause identifies a beneficial owner by entitlement to more than 15 percent of CAPITAL OR PROFITS. T6BO02's WORKING-STORAGE (lines 6-10) has only WS-PROFIT-SHARE -- no capital-percentage field exists anywhere in the program -- and 2100-CHECK-PROFIT-SHARE tests only the profit leg (line 18). The capital-ownership half of the disjunctive obligation is entirely unimplemented, even though the profit check itself uses the correct 2016 threshold.

provenance.annotator_notes: Human primary annotation and Claude verification agreed on this classification without final review.
